name: Brand Governance, Campaign Matrix & Localization Studio
description: Lints marketing copy against brand voice rules, prohibited claims, and channel limits, validates audience-by-channel multimodal campaign matrices, and audits global localization packs against do-not-translate glossaries.

skills.summary: Lints marketing copy for banned guarantees, missing substantiation disclaimers, readability density, and channel char caps.
Audits audience-by-channel and funnel coverage matrices, planned spend vs budget, and critical-path launch buffers.
Verifies target locale translations for missing markets, untranslated leaks, DNT term preservation, and regional glossary fidelity.

byo_mcp: Localization TMS & Brand CMS MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Query Google Drive, SharePoint, and Docs via remote_cli mcp or Workspace tools to pull brand guidelines, campaign copy decks, and locale translation sheets before running copy and glossary lint checks in Python.

gateway_approval_actions: Publishing public campaign copy or paid ad assets via CMS MCP or shared workspace channels
Sending external agency creative briefs or translation sign-offs over email or Slack
python_code_guardrails: Unverified superlative, ROI, and missing mandatory claim disclaimer blocker
Strict Do-Not-Translate (DNT) brand glossary and channel character-limit enforcement
Brand color/tone deviation and critical-path campaign dependency cycle checks

scheduled_routine.name: weekly-campaign-compliance-sweep
scheduled_routine.title: Weekly Campaign Compliance Sweep
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the weekly marketing compliance sweep via scripts/copy_compliance_linter.py across upcoming campaign drafts and flag missing disclaimers or prohibited claims.
